why: In each row the third figure keeps only the parts that are NOT common to the first two figures. Row 1: the vertical bar and the dot cancel and four slanting bars remain (an X); row 2: the left and right petals cancel, leaving the up and down petals. In row 3 the up-left, up-right and down arrows cancel, leaving only the left and right arrows: option 4. Option 3 is wrong because it still keeps the common down arrow.
trick: If figure 3 looks like a mix of 1 and 2, try 'remove what is common, keep what is different'.
